block_level_exploratory_tests.interpretation_limit: directions were always recorded in the fixed within-position order UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT; direction effects may therefore include order or recording drift. There is one recording block per position×direction, so causal separation is unsupported; 20 windows within a block are summarized, not treated as independent inferential replicates; the fixed-position tests are exploratory, with validation n=4 positions

dataset_loader_behavior: complete compressed NPZ decode and X_raw finite check, then immediate train/validation selection
hardware_filter_metadata: not specified in the inspected raw recording header; header states 250 Hz and OpenBCI GUI Cyton board

periodogram.channel_aggregation: mean power over four S0-S3 channels

raw_window_status_from_dataset_readme: X_raw retains unfiltered EXG windows; 0.5-12 Hz plus 75-sample smoothed envelope used only for action localization
